title: A dated milestone IS the record of its own completion
setup: sp_goa_dec milestones Flights (target Aug 29), Stay (target Sep 10).
expected: the Flights milestone flips to state "done" and keeps the booking episode in its "episodes"; the space's summary/latest reflect the progress. The MILESTONE LIST is the only place that milestone's state lives — decide.v9 has no second structure for it.

wrong.label: dual-bookkeeping
wrong.assert_absent: the same milestone's state kept in a SECOND structure beside "milestones" — a parallel "chapters" array, or the same stage listed twice. (Closing the booking TASK in "closures" is a DIFFERENT object and is correct: a task closure is not a copy of a milestone.)

source.section: GoldenEvals V6P1 §1.1 (carried) CHP-03 · Dated chapter = milestone — re-authored at the S6 gate onto the V6 vocabulary. V2 forbade "milestones tracked apart from chapters"; decide.v9 renamed chapters to milestones and emits nothing else, so the forbidden shape WAS the shipped shape and the case could only fail. Same assertion, named on the surviving object — and the exclusion says plainly that a task closure in "closures" is a separate object, because the first re-authoring did not and the judge read every closure as a duplicate.
